distribution_model.detail: Owns and operates two casino resorts, Atlantis in Reno and Monarch in Black Hawk; guests book rooms, tables, spa directly.

market_position.detail: Upscale, AAA Four Diamond and Forbes-recognized casino resorts, marketed as luxury destinations.

notes: Market position could be read as premium or luxury; premium chosen given regional casino resort positioning.

product_category.detail: Casino gaming, hotel rooms, restaurants, spa and meeting space at resort properties.

purchase_frequency.detail: Leisure and business trips to casino resorts, chosen at guests' discretion.

sub_sector.value: regional casino resorts in Nevada and Colorado
